pool.arabic: كل مدينة بالعراق بيها معلم مشهور.
pool.arabicTashkeel: كُل مَدينة بالعِراق بيها مَعلَم مَشهور.
pool.english: Every city in Iraq has a famous landmark.
pool.transliteration: kull madeena bil-3iraaq beeha ma3lam mash-hoor.

pool.english: Baghdad is the capital of Iraq.
There are hundreds of archaeological sites in the south.

pool.arabic: زقورة أور عمرها أكثر من أربع آلاف سنة.
pool.arabicTashkeel: زَقّورة أور عُمُرها أكثَر مِن أربَع آلاف سَنة.
pool.english: The Ziggurat of Ur is more than four thousand years old.
pool.transliteration: zaggoorat oor 3umurha akthar min arba3 aalaaf sana.

pool.english: We took a boat trip in the Marshes.

Iraqi generosity is famous.
Iraqis are very hospitable.

Every visitor gets tea and a smile.

Mesopotamia is the cradle of civilization.

pool.arabic: ملايين يزورون مرقد الإمام الحسين بكربلاء.
pool.arabicTashkeel: مَلايين يزورون مَرقَد الإمام الحُسَين بكَربَلاء.
pool.english: Millions visit the Imam Hussein shrine in Karbala.
pool.transliteration: malaayeen yzooroon margad il-imaam il-7usayn b-karbalaa2.

Visitors come from all over the world.

The Sumerian civilization invented writing.

pool.arabic: مرقد الإمام علي بالنجف إله قبة ذهبية.
pool.arabicTashkeel: مَرقَد الإمام عَلي بالنَّجَف إلَه قُبّة ذَهَبية.
pool.english: The Imam Ali shrine in Najaf has a golden dome.
pool.transliteration: margad il-imaam 3ali bin-najaf ila gubba dhahabiyya.

pool.english: The historic gates of Baghdad.
My impression is that people here are very kind.
The Iraq Museum is an important landmark.
The capital is crowded and lively.
The archaeologists found new statues.
We climbed the steps of the ziggurat.
The Marsh Arabs live in reed houses.

pool.arabic: بلاد الرافدين إنطت العالم أول القوانين.
pool.arabicTashkeel: بِلاد الرّافِدَين إنطَت العالَم أوَّل القَوانين.
pool.english: Mesopotamia gave the world the first laws.
pool.transliteration: bilaad ir-raafidayn intat il-3aalam awwal il-gawaaneen.

pool.english: Generosity is part of Iraqi culture.
The people of Basra are hospitable.

sentences.arabic: الربيع الفات صديقي من لندن زار العراق لأول مرة.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: الرَّبيع الفات صَديقي مِن لَندَن زار العِراق لأوَّل مَرّة.
sentences.english: Last spring my friend from London visited Iraq for the first time.
sentences.transliteration: ir-rabee3 il-faat sadeegi min landan zaar il-3iraaq l-awwal marra.

sentences.arabic: بدينا بالعاصمة، بجولة ببغداد القديمة وشارع المتنبي.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: بدَينا بالعاصِمة، بجَولة ببَغداد القَديمة وشارِع المُتَنَبّي.
sentences.english: We started in the capital, with a tour of old Baghdad and Al-Mutanabbi Street.
sentences.transliteration: bdeena bil-3aasima, b-jawla b-baghdaad il-gadeema w-shaari3 il-mutanabbi.

sentences.arabic: بعدين نزلنا للجنوب حتى نشوف بابل وزقورة أور.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: بَعدين نِزَلنا للجَنوب حَتّى نْشوف بابِل وزَقّورة أور.
sentences.english: Then we went south to see Babylon and the Ziggurat of Ur.
sentences.transliteration: ba3deen nizalna lij-janoob 7atta nshoof baabil w-zaggoorat oor.

sentences.arabic: قال: هذا مهد الحضارة، أحس بالتاريخ هنا.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: قال: هَذا مَهد الحَضارة، أحِس بالتّاريخ هْنا.
sentences.english: He said: This is the cradle of civilization; I can feel the history here.
sentences.transliteration: gaal: haatha mahd il-7adhaara, a7iss bit-taareekh hnaa.

sentences.arabic: بالأهوار، عائلة عزمتنا لبيتهم القصب وسوتلنا شاي وسمك.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: بالأهوار، عائلة عَزّمتنا لبيتهُم القَصَب وسَوّتلنا شاي وسِمَك.
sentences.english: In the Marshes, a family invited us into their reed house and made us tea and fish.
sentences.transliteration: bil-ahwaar, 3aa2ila 3azzamatna l-beethum il-gasab w-sawwatilna chaay w-simach.

sentences.arabic: إنطباعه؟ العراقيين أكثر ناس مضيافين شافهم بحياته.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: إنطِباعَه؟ العِراقيين أكثَر ناس مِضيافين شافهُم بحَياتَه.
sentences.english: His impression? Iraqis are the most hospitable people he has ever met.
sentences.transliteration: intibaa3a? il-3iraaqiyyeen akthar naas midhyaafeen shaafhum b-7ayaata.

sentences.arabic: الجو بالعراق حار بالصيف، بس الربيع والخريف حلوين.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: الجَو بالعِراق حار بالصّيف، بَس الرَّبيع والخَريف حِلوين.
sentences.english: The weather in Iraq is hot in summer, but spring and autumn are beautiful.
sentences.transliteration: ij-jaw bil-3iraaq 7aarr bis-seef, bas ir-rabee3 w-il-khareef 7ilween.

sentences.arabic: أحسن وكت للزيارة من تشرين لنيسان.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: أحسَن وَكِت للزِّيارة مِن تِشرين لنيسان.
sentences.english: The best time to visit is from October to April.
sentences.transliteration: a7san wakit liz-ziyaara min tishreen l-neesaan.

sentences.arabic: وين ما تروح، راح تلقى كرم وترحيب حار.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: وين ما تْروح، راح تِلقى كَرَم وتَرحيب حار.
sentences.english: Wherever you go, you will find generosity and a warm welcome.
sentences.transliteration: ween ma trooh, raa7 tilga karam w-tar7eeb 7aarr.

scenario.situation: The student is helping a foreign friend plan their first visit to Iraq and asks an Iraqi travel guide for advice.
scenario.studentRole: Someone planning a trip, learning Iraqi Arabic.
scenario.goalEnglish: Ask which cities and landmarks to visit (Baghdad, Babylon, Ur, the Marshes, the shrines), when the weather is best, and what visitors should know about Iraqi culture and hospitality.
